items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs, for every differential graded A-module, a quasi-isomorphic embedding into a module with property (I) (statement lines 2707-2717). The proof (lines 2719-2752) mirrors the resolution construction on the injective side, with the genuine work in the span: the inductive co-resolution from the good-sub embeddings, the product-total assembly with explicit grading and signed differential, the interleaved filtration whose graded pieces are products of shifts of A-dual with admissible inclusions verified through the injectivity lemma, and the closing quasi-isomorphism from the homology co-resolution lemma. H2: the product-variant assembly of the property (I) filtration is the non-formal content; this lemma is the injective twin of the property-(P) resolution and drives the property-(I) reductions of the chapter.
